authorship: Hand-authored export binding and marker-durability witnesses over docs/A1_RECOVERY_CONTRACT.md section 6. No production persistence code exists or was consulted.

cases.title: Exact export success stores the complete binding

expected.law: Only bound delivery plus A0 publication reaches A1; the record persists the document ID, revision, timestamp, semantic hash, and artifact byte length and digest.

cases.title: lastExport is only the derived display subset

expected.law: A later envelope may carry the subset only after exact A1 binding success; the subset never substitutes for the stored binding.

cases.title: Download cancellation never advances the marker

expected.law: Cancellation or delivery failure leaves the in-session marker exactly where it was.

cases.title: A stale marker for a superseded revision refuses
cases.scenario: The document advanced to revision 14 while an export bound to revision 9 was pending.

expected.law: A0 preserves the newer state and A1 refuses the stale marker without any write.

cases.title: Failed binding persistence stays visibly pending

expected.law: Unavailable, failed, or malformed persistence remains visibly pending without a cross-reload claim.

cases.title: A malformed binding refuses with a stable code
A binding for a different document refuses

expected.law: The binding's document ID must equal the service's bound document.

cases.title: Exported and changed-since-export statuses use the frozen vocabulary

expected.law: Only the {revision} substitution exists; no string may call recovery a save.
